system.description:
While you are in a Brawl with a single enemy, you are the only one Brawling it, and no ally has targeted it during the Brawl, you are Steeled and gain 1 extra Attack Action.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.76
system.summary: While you are in a Brawl with a single enemy, you are the only one Brawling it, and no ally has targeted it during the Brawl, you are Steeled and gain 1 extra Attack Action.

when.label: Showdown: you're the only one in a Brawl with a single enemy that no ally has targeted during the Brawl

automation.note: Use this when the Showdown conditions start to mark yourself Steeled (it clears at the end of combat). Remove Steeled sooner if someone else joins the Brawl or an ally targets the enemy. The tracker always counts the extra Attack Action; only take it while the conditions hold.
